I fixed the site's appearance by reverting two bad values in `site/css/styles.css`. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass against the existing baselines, so I didn't approve or change any baselines.

- **Small text:** `small, .small` had `font-size: 0.438em`, which made the "SKU: BST-498" label tiny. This shrank the page and shifted everything below it up (5px on desktop, 10px on phone). I set it back to `0.875em`.
- **Navbar caret:** `.dropdown-toggle::after` had `margin-left: 0.383em`, which moved the "Shop" dropdown arrow. I set it back to `0.255em`.

I haven't committed anything.
